services.name: Downtown Chicago Tour
services.desc: The best helicopter tours in Chicago are with Heli Chicago! 45 minutes About Make memories that will last a lifetime! Hop in as we begin our tour from Schaumburg Regional Airport and head East to the Chicago Skyline. We'll fly past the United Center, Soldier field, Willis Tower (formerly the Sears Tower), the John Hancock Building, and Wrigley Field... Sorry Sox fans. Next we'll turn back towards the South and pass along the backside of all those buildings. At this point you may be noticing all the Chicago traffic and be glad you decided to skip that by flying high above it! 45 Minutes • Ages 4+ • Up to 3 People per Flight • Most Popular

services.name: Northwest Side Tour
services.desc: The best helicopter tours in Chicago are with Heli Chicago! 30 Minutes 30 minute ride takes you on a tour of Northwest Chicago. You’ll fly past Woodfield Mall, Barrington Hills, the Grand Victoria Casino, and along the Fox River! We also suggest: taking this tours with the doors off! Know Before You Go Aircraft: Hughes 369 Up to three people per flight Ages 30 Minutes • Ages 4+ • Up to 3 People per Flight • The Best Way to See Chicago's Suburbs

services.name: Intro Flight
services.desc: Bird's Eye View of Chicago's Northwest Suburbs! 30 Minutes About Strap in and take the controls to see what it takes to fly this Vietnam era helicopter. With guidance from one of our experienced instructors, you’ll be on your way to pro pilot status in no time! Want to sit back and relax instead? No problem! Let your Pilot do all the work while you get a bird’s eye view of the Northwest suburbs of Chicago! Know Before You Go Aircraft: Hughes 369 Up to three people per flight Ages 30 Minutes • Ages 4+ • Up to 3 People per Flight • Great For Aviation Enthusiasts

blurb: Guests can take helicopter tours over downtown Chicago, including a popular 45-minute tour showcasing landmarks like Navy Pier and Willis Tower. They also offer a unique 30-minute experience where guests can pilot a Vietnam-flown helicopter. Tours depart from Schaumburg Regional Airport and feature turbine-powered helicopters with noise-cancelling headsets.

quotes.text: Our pilot Wayne and Sara were beyond spectacular and had a good variety of jokes. They were very polite and punctual which was appreciated. I felt very calm with their presence and they made me feel completely relaxed and not worried for the flight. I was very nervous but they reassured me that everything would be smooth. The ride was beautiful and the pilots completed the experience.

Absolutely an AMAZING experience from start to finish! Our pilot – Chris – was super friendly and an absolute PRO at his profession! You can tell he has a true passion for what he does. From booking/scheduling, confirmations and even accommodating small changes along the way were a breeze. Chris was hit with our daughters and did not hesitate every second of the flight with any of their conversation/questions. He really made it special!!! You have to take a helicopter tour of Chicago and you HAVE TO use Chris at (the REAL) Heli Chicago!!!!
